test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 12 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A drum contains 80 litres of a 90% pure acid solution. If 8 litres of this solution are removed and replaced with 8 litres of pure water, what is the new percentage of acid in the solution?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

New Acid Percentage = Initial Percentage × (1 − Replacement Volume ÷ Total Volume)

New Acid Percentage = 90% × (1 − 8 ÷ 80)

New Acid Percentage = 90% × (1 − 1/10)

New Acid Percentage = 90% × 0.9 = 81%

**∴ The correct answer is 81%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total volume of **acid solution** = 80 litres

Initial concentration of **pure acid** = 90%

Volume removed and replaced with **pure water** = 8 litres

**Formula Used:**

Final Quantity = Initial Quantity × (1 − x/V)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cea3b809538217fab90ed27c67adeca96c95753a740acc7ab7d8f1dcc0b53460.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Initial amount of **pure acid** = 90% of 80 = (90 ÷ 100) × 80 = 72 litres

⇒ Amount of **pure acid** in 8 litres removed = 90% of 8 = (90 ÷ 100) × 8 = 7.2 litres

⇒ **Pure acid** remaining in the drum = 72 − 7.2 = 64.8 litres

⇒ Total volume of solution after adding **pure water** = (80 − 8) + 8 = 80 litres

⇒ New percentage of **pure acid** = (Amount of remaining acid ÷ Total volume) × 100

⇒ New percentage = (64.8 ÷ 80) × 100 = 648 ÷ 8 = 81%

**∴ The correct answer is 81%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Replacement Formula

If 'x' volume is replaced 'n' times from a total volume 'V', the final quantity of the original liquid is Qf = Qᵢ × (1 − x/V)ⁿ.

Dilution Concept

When pure water is added to a mixture, the quantity of the solute (acid) remains constant, but its percentage decreases as the total solution volume increases.

Concentration Ratio

The ratio of the final concentration to the initial concentration is equal to the ratio of the volume of acid remaining to the initial volume of acid.</p
